DB_TYPE.description: Database engine: postgres for production, sqlite for local dev

PG_HOSTNAME.description: PostgreSQL server hostname (companion DB or localhost)

PG_DATABASE.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database for Keycloak

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Initial admin username; change via Admin UI later

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Initial admin password; used first startup only

KC_PROXY.description: Proxy mode: edge (Railway), passthrough, or reencrypt

KC_HTTP_ENABLED.description: Enable HTTP listener (HTTPS only recommended for Railway)

KEYCLOAK_HOSTNAME.description: Public URL users will access Keycloak at (match your domain)

PORT.description: Port the service listens on inside the container
